profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lumion
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm a senior full-stack & AI engineer with 12+ years of high-quality experience in the Laravel ecosystem, 10+ years at Kirschbaum Development Group, one of the first official Laravel premier partners. 

I combine full-stack success with cutting-edge AI skills and services to deliver exceptional solutions.

⚡ Core Tech Stack
• Backend & DB: Laravel, PHP, Livewire, Python, MySQL, PostgreSQL (pgvector)
• Frontend: Vue, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
• Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3, ECR, EC2, Lambda)
• AI & Workflows: Claude Accounts, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini & Antigravity, multi-agent orchestration, custom agentic tooling

🛠 Key AI & Engineering Highlights
• Production RAG & Vector Search: Built full-stack semantic search pipelines featuring embedding models, PostgreSQL cosine similarity, and low-latency retrieval for LLM applications.
• Conversational Discovery & Lead Gen: Shipped an AI sales chatbot that drives inbound qualification, captures structured data, and automates lead scoring.
• Developer Productivity Tooling: Created custom AI-driven workflows and automation tools to streamline ticket management, version control, code reviews, video demos, and CI delivery tasks.

📚 Influential Reads & Learning
• Architecture & Quality: Laravel Beyond CRUD (Spatie), POODR (Sandi Metz), The Clean Coder (Bob Martin), Head First Design Patterns (Eric Freeman), MySQL for Developers (Aaron Francis), Indexing Beyond the Basics (Tobias Petry)
• Craft & Mastery: Test-Driven Laravel, Refactoring to Collections, Refactoring UI (Adam Wathan), Eloquent Performance Patterns (Jonathan Reinink), The Phoenix Project (Gene Kim)
• Community: Lifetime subscriber to Laracasts & VueSchool, frequent Laracon attendee

I intentionally bring a positive, collaborative attitude with a problem-solving mindset to the team! My love for building things with technology is what drives me. I'm always happy to connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lumion is building the AI-first operating system for trade and technical schools, removing administrative bottlenecks across enrollment, tuition servicing, compliance, and student success so the next generation of skilled tradespeople can launch meaningful careers.
 
• Contributing to the core full-stack platform powering 400+ career institutions and 150,000+ students nationwide.
 • Full-stack engineering across a Laravel and modern frontend stack using AI-accelerated development practices.
 • Leveraging AI-native workflows, agentic coding tools, and modern web architectures to rapidly build and ship scalable product features.
 • Partnering across product and engineering to transform traditional school workflows into seamless, AI-augmented student experiences.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Laravel web applications and AWS Lambdas using PHP, VueJS, ReactJS, TailwindCSS, Python, Filament, Inertia, Nova, Forge, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, Git, Jira, MySQL, and ChatGPT.  Built large blocks libraries from Figma designs using pure CSS on one project and Tailwind on another.

Courses & Books I've enjoyed: Laravel Beyond CRUD - Spatie | Test-Driven Laravel - Adam Watham | Advanced Vue Component Design - Adam Watham | Eloquent Performance Patterns - Jonathan Reinink | Vue - The Complete Guide - Maximilian Schwarzmuller | Refactoring to Collections - Adam Watham | Refactoring UI - Adam Watham | Laracasts - lifetime subscriber | Practical Object-Oriented Design - Sandi Metz | Head First Design Patterns - Eric Freeman | The Clean Coder - Bob Martin | The Phoenix Project: A Novel about IT, DevOps, and Helping Your Business Win - Gene Kim
positions.insights: Skills: VueJS · Tailwind CSS · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda · PHP · Inertia.js · Laravel · Agentic AI Development · JavaScript
